name: Shaman
playstyle: Hybrid Melee / Caster / Healer — Maelstrom Weapon (Enh), Lava Burst & Overload (Ele), Riptide & Water Shield (Resto), indoor Ghost Wolf

base_bar1.PAD1 (B): Lightning Bolt (instant w/ Maelstrom) / Stormstrike / Healing Wave
base_bar1.PAD3 (Y): Flame Shock / Chain Lightning / Chain Heal
base_bar1.PAD4 (X): Frost Shock / Purge / Lesser Healing Wave
base_bar1.PADDUP: Earthbind Totem (roots in Ele) / Tremor Totem

macros.name: PW_SHM_INT
macros.description: Cancels current cast and interrupts immediately with Earth Shock

macros.name: PW_SHM_WLF
macros.description: Toggles Ghost Wolf cleanly (usable indoors in WoW Forever)

macros.name: PW_SHM_HEAL
macros.description: Smart Lesser Healing Wave on mouseover, friendly target, or yourself
macros.body:
#showtooltip Lesser Healing Wave
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Lesser Healing Wave

macros.name: PW_SHM_TOT
macros.description: One-button cycling totem drop sequence (resets after 6s or combat change)
macros.body:
#showtooltip
/castsequence reset=6 Strength of Earth Totem, Windfury Totem, Mana Spring Totem, Searing Totem

consolePortNotes: Group situational totems (Tremor, Poison Cleansing, Resistance) into a ConsolePort Utility Ring. Elemental/Resto Shamans can raise GamePadFaceMovementMaxAngle to 115 if preferred.
